name: What kind of maintenance does tile flooring require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does tile flooring require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile flooring is generally low-maintenance. Regular sweeping or vacuuming keeps dirt and debris at bay. For cleaning, a damp mop with a pH-neutral cleaner is usually sufficient. Grout lines may require occasional scrubbing with a specialized cleaner to prevent staining and mildew. Natural stone tiles, however, require sealing periodically to protect against stains and moisture. Always use cleaners recommended for your specific tile type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile flooring needs regular sweeping and mopping with a pH-neutral cleaner. Grout may need occasional scrubbing, and natural stone tiles require periodic sealing.
